===========================================================
❤️ HOW TO ADD YOUR GIRLFRIEND'S PHOTOS & MUSIC ❤️
===========================================================

1. PHOTOS:
Place her photos inside this folder:
/public/assets/photos/

Recommended names or formats:
- photo1.jpg (or .png / .webp)
- photo2.jpg
- photo3.jpg
- photo4.jpg

Then in `src/config/loveData.js`, under `memories.gallery`, simply point `image` to:
"/assets/photos/photo1.jpg"

(If you leave it as is, the site will show the beautiful romantic illustrations provided by default!)

2. ROMANTIC MUSIC:
Place your favourite romantic background song in this folder:
/public/assets/romantic-music.mp3

The music button will automatically detect and play it!
If no MP3 is added, the site has a built-in soothing music-box lullaby synthesizer, so it works out of the box.

Enjoy celebrating your love! ❤️
